steps.en: Install it on Python 3.11+ (wheels ship the Rust core)
steps.zh: 在 Python 3.11+ 上安装（wheel 自带 Rust 内核）

steps.en: Set the screen size, then hand it your update and draw functions
steps.zh: 定好画面尺寸，把 update 和 draw 两个函数交给它

steps.en: Run the script (watch mode re-runs it on save)
steps.zh: 运行脚本（watch 模式保存即重跑）
steps.code: pyxel run PYTHON_SCRIPT_FILE · pyxel watch WATCH_DIR PYTHON_SCRIPT_FILE

steps.en: Opens the window, calls update every frame and draw when time allows, mixes 4 sound channels
steps.zh: 开窗口，每帧调 update、来得及才调 draw，混 4 路声音

steps.en: Bundle the game directory into one .pyxapp, then convert it to HTML
steps.zh: 把游戏目录打成一个 .pyxapp，再转成 HTML
steps.code: pyxel package APP_DIR STARTUP_SCRIPT_FILE · pyxel app2html PYXEL_APP_FILE

steps.en: Embeds code and assets in one HTML file that runs its WebAssembly build in the browser
steps.zh: 把代码和资源嵌进一个 HTML，浏览器里跑它的 WebAssembly 版

value.en: No window, game loop, palette renderer or sound mixer to write — and the same Python file plays on desktop and in a browser link
value.zh: 不用自己写窗口、游戏循环、调色板渲染和混音——同一份 Python 在桌面和网页链接里都能玩

sources: https://github.com/kitao/pyxel docs/user-guide.md — How to Install (pip install -U pyxel, Python 3.11+), Pyxel Command usage list (pyxel run PYTHON_SCRIPT_FILE, pyxel watch WATCH_DIR PYTHON_SCRIPT_FILE, pyxel package APP_DIR STARTUP_SCRIPT_FILE, pyxel app2html PYXEL_APP_FILE), Create a Program (pyxel.init(160, 120), pyxel.run(update, draw)), Specifications (16 colors, 4 channels)
https://github.com/kitao/pyxel docs/faq.md — update is called every frame, draw may be skipped when over budget
https://github.com/kitao/pyxel docs/web-usage.md — app2html embeds all code and resources in the HTML, version pinned at conversion

https://github.com/kitao/pyxel python/pyxel/cli.py — app2html writes a script tag for cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kitao/pyxel@<version>/wasm/pyxel.js; wasm/pyxel.js loads Pyodide from cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide
https://github.com/kitao/pyxel crates/pyxel-core (Cargo.toml: glow, platform/sdl2) and crates/pyxel-binding (pyo3) — Rust core behind the Python API
